title: The batch poll loop holds its modes in control flow: a BatchWatch union with transition() could name them
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/upload-pipeline.ts processBatch: the while loop, realCompleted, the 10-min maxPollTime deadline and the abort signal carry processing, error, done, timed out and cancelled implicitly. Candidate shape (C18 design §6): BatchWatch = processing | error | done | timedOut | cancelled, events pollOk | pollFailed | deadline | cancel, with a table test. C18 (US-12 AC24) kept the minimal fix by owner ruling Q2
